fdm.title: FDM 3D Printing
fdm.subtitle: Source high-performing parts for rapid prototyping and low-volume industrial production with FDM 3D printing. We offer an FDM printing service for quick-turn manufacturing using a variety of robust materials for many use cases and can print parts in 1 day.

blocks.x: FDM (Fused Deposition Modeling), also known as Fused Filament Fabrication, is an additive manufacturing process that heats thermoplastic filament and deposits it layer by layer to build parts from a digital CAD model. It is the most widely used 3D printing technology globally, accounting for the largest installed base of 3D printers worldwide. FDM is the first process engineers consider for rapid prototyping and functional parts due to its cost-effectiveness and versatility.

FDM builds parts by depositing melted filament onto a build platform layer by layer until the part is complete. The process starts with a digital design file translated into machine instructions. The filament is fed into a heated nozzle, melted, and extruded in thin strands along a programmed toolpath. Each strand cools and fuses to the previous layer to form a solid geometry. The build platform lowers after each layer, and the cycle repeats until the full part is produced.

items: Digital design file is converted to machine instructions
Thermoplastic filament is fed into the heated nozzle
Material melts and is extruded in thin strands
Nozzle moves along programmed toolpath (X, Y, Z axes)
Layers cool and fuse to form solid geometry
Build platform lowers for each new layer
Process repeats until part is complete

injection-molding.title: Injection Molding
injection-molding.subtitle: Mass production of high-precision plastic parts in Chennai with rapid turnaround times and competitive pricing for automotive, industrial, and consumer applications.

blocks.x: Injection Molding is a manufacturing process used to produce plastic parts in large quantities by injecting molten plastic material into a custom-made metal mold. After cooling and solidifying, the part is ejected from the mold. VCAN 3D provides high-precision injection molding services in Chennai for automotive, industrial, and consumer applications. This process is ideal for producing thousands to millions of identical parts with excellent consistency and repeatability.

Injection molding follows a precise sequence of steps to transform plastic granules into finished parts. The process begins with material preparation and ends with quality inspection, ensuring each part meets exact specifications.

items: Plastic granules are fed into a heated barrel and melted
Molten plastic is mixed and homogenized
Material is injected into a custom metal mold under high pressure
Plastic fills the mold cavity completely
Cooling system solidifies the plastic
Mold opens and finished part is ejected
Process repeats for the next cycle

sla.title: SLA 3D Printing
sla.subtitle: High-precision resin-based manufacturing in Chennai with exceptional accuracy and surface quality. Our SLA services deliver detailed parts for prototypes, precision components, and visual models.

blocks.x: SLA (Stereolithography) is a resin-based 3D printing technology that uses a UV laser to cure (harden) liquid photopolymer resin layer by layer to create highly detailed parts. VCAN 3D's SLA services in Chennai deliver exceptional accuracy and surface quality for prototypes and precision components. SLA is the original 3D printing technology and remains the gold standard for applications requiring fine details and smooth surface finishes.

SLA builds parts by selectively curing liquid resin with a UV laser according to the digital design. The process builds parts layer by layer from the bottom up, with each new layer curing onto the previous one.

items: Build platform is lowered into a tank of liquid photopolymer resin
UV laser scans the cross-section of the layer, curing the resin
Platform raises slightly to allow fresh resin to flow beneath
Platform lowers for the next layer
Process repeats layer by layer until part is complete
Part is removed from tank and cleaned in isopropyl alcohol
Final UV post-curing to achieve maximum material properties

sls-mjf-dlp.title: SLS / MJF / DLP 3D Printing
sls-mjf-dlp.subtitle: Advanced Industrial 3D Printing Technologies in Chennai offering strong, functional parts without support structures. We provide SLS, MJF, and DLP services for complex geometries and production-grade components.

blocks.x: SLS (Selective Laser Sintering) is a 3D printing technology that uses a high-power laser to fuse powdered material (usually Nylon/PA12) layer by layer to create strong and functional parts. Unlike FDM, SLS does not require support structures because the surrounding powder supports the part during printing. VCAN 3D's SLS services in Chennai are ideal for functional prototypes and end-use parts requiring high strength and complex geometries.

MJF (Multi Jet Fusion) is HP's industrial 3D printing technology that uses a multi-agent printing process to fuse powder layer by layer. It offers faster build times and excellent mechanical properties, making it suitable for production-grade parts. VCAN 3D's MJF services in Chennai provide high-quality nylon parts with consistent properties across production runs.

DLP (Digital Light Processing) is a resin-based 3D printing technology that uses a digital projector to cure entire layers of photopolymer resin simultaneously. DLP offers faster print speeds than SLA for certain applications while maintaining high resolution. VCAN 3D's DLP services in Chennai are ideal for detailed parts and small batch production.
Each technology uses a different approach to build parts, but all follow the principle of additive manufacturing by building layer by layer from a digital design.

items: A thin layer of powder is spread on the build platform
High-power laser selectively fuses the powder according to CAD design
Platform lowers and new powder layer is spread
Process repeats layer by layer until part is complete
Build chamber cools down to stabilize parts
Excess powder is removed and parts are extracted
Media blasting to remove residual powder
A thin layer of powder is spread on the build platform
Fusing agent is applied where material should be solid
Detailing agent is applied at edges for precision
Infrared lamp passes over to fuse the powder
Platform lowers and new powder layer is spread
Process repeats until build is complete
Parts are removed from powder and cleaned
Build platform is lowered into resin tank
Digital projector flashes entire layer image onto resin
Resin cures where exposed to light
Platform raises for next layer
Process repeats until part is complete
Part is cleaned in isopropyl alcohol
UV post-curing for final properties

vacuum-casting.title: Vacuum Casting
vacuum-casting.subtitle: High-quality plastic parts in small batches using silicone molds in Chennai. Our vacuum casting service produces parts that closely resemble injection-molded components at a fraction of the cost, ideal for 10-100+ parts.

blocks.x: Vacuum Casting is a manufacturing process used to produce high-quality plastic parts in small batches using a silicone mold under vacuum conditions. VCAN 3D's vacuum casting service in Chennai is mainly used for low-volume production and for creating parts that closely resemble injection-molded components at a fraction of the cost. This process is ideal for bridge production between prototyping and full-scale injection molding, offering excellent surface finish and material properties.

Vacuum casting follows a systematic process that starts with creating a master model and ends with producing multiple copies from a silicone mold. The vacuum environment ensures that no air bubbles are trapped in the final parts.

items: Master model is created using SLA or DLP 3D printing
Master is finished and polished to required surface quality
Silicone rubber is poured around the master in a mold box
Silicone cures to form a flexible mold
Master is removed from the silicone mold
Mold is placed in a vacuum chamber
Liquid polyurethane resin is poured into the mold under vacuum
Resin cures and finished part is removed from mold
Process repeats for additional parts from the same mold
